page.overview:
Who is Donny Buc?

Donny Buc was a spacer that ran a regular route between Coruscant and Sorrus over a decade before the Battle of Naboo. Padawans Obi-Wan Kenobi and Siri Tachi arranged passage to Coruscant with him, after a failed attempt to capture Ona Nobis.
